content: Vulkan-Hpp (KhronosGroup/Vulkan-Hpp) and Vulkan-Utility-Libraries (KhronosGroup/Vulkan-Utility-Libraries) are both Apache-2.0, maintained by Khronos directly, versioned alongside the Vulkan SDK (e.g. vulkan-sdk-1.4.341 tag). Vulkan-Hpp is a header-only C++ binding layer over the C API with zero runtime cost -- directly compatible with the already-vendored Vulkan-Headers submodule (same VK_HEADER_VERSION lineage).
